summary: Stockton Rush, heir to an American oil fortune, founded OceanGate in 2009 and sold tourist dives to the Titanic in an experimental carbon fiber submersible, ignoring safety warnings until it imploded in 2023, killing him and four passengers.

notes: The ancestry segment (Richard Stockton, Benjamin Rush, Ralph K. Davies) is treated as family background, so covered_span starts at Rush's 1962 birth; it still earns slavery-forced-labor. Setting CA is inferred: the Titanic wreck lies in international waters off Newfoundland and the transcript only says the ship was registered in Canada. reaches_present is true because the aftermath (media framing, rescue costs, conspiracy theories) gets real time at release.
